snippet.title: Necesse Version 1.0 is now live!
snippet.description:
Necesse Version 1.0 is now live on steam!

Experience the infinite seamless world, the vast endgame of incursions or just chill out and build a nice base!

To see everything that's coming with Necesse Version 1.0, check out our official steam release post below:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1169040/view/676227805148610689

If you’d like to learn more about Necesse, check out our Steam link or social media channels below.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169040?utm_source=nsm&utm_campaign=youtube 
Discord: https://discord.gg/qU3CtRHhBw
